To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
BPSK is the most suitable modulation technique for the flat fading channel.

the BER performance of OFDM system is better in Rayleigh and AWGN channels as compared to Rician and frequency selective fading channels and the performance of OFDM is better in case of 64 QAM modulation than BPSK and QPSK.
BPSK and QPSK are better suited for Rayleigh and Rician fading environments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis and comparison of the performance of various channel estimation methods under different modulation schemes in different fading environments.
the analysis of channel performance using different modulation techniques over different types of fading channels.
the performance analysis of various modulation techniques under the influence of various fading channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the QAM modulations perform better than QPSK, which in turn outperforms BPSK.
the BER performance of the system is better for BPSK than for other modulation schemes.
OFDM is a very effective modulation technique for high data rate wireless transmission.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the performance of OFDM system is best for BPSK modulation scheme in Rayleigh channel, for 64 QAM in flat fading channel, and QPSK in Rician channel.
QPSK and 16-QAM are better suited for Rayleigh and Rician fading environments respectively, while BPSK is better suited for AWGN and flat fading channels.
the performance of the channel depends on the modulation scheme, the channel environment and also on the SNR of the channel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
QAM is more suitable in the presence of noise and fading than BPSK and QPSK.
OFDM is more suitable for high data rates and can be implemented with different modulation techniques.
the performance of the channel estimation depends on the modulation scheme and the type of the fading environment.
